summary: A single-instrument synthesizer firmware grown from the SLOOP groovebox, with 23 synthesis engines and 407 sounds. It has no tracks, drum machine, song mode or built-in samples.
features: HYBRID voice: three oscillators, two filters, 16-slot mod matrix
Engines include FMX, FM6 with DX7 banks, JUNO, WSEQ and VECTOR
Mod matrix, MOD SEQ and four macros on every engine
Microtuning with Scala files; LAYER, SPLIT and two-part MULTI
Arpeggiator with a Turing machine, step sequencer, MPE, USB and TRS MIDI
8 voices by default; on-device testing is still ongoing
